note: He is the purest 'good to great' case in the batch and emphatically not deconditioned — 53, trains most days, calisthenics on rings, chasing a free handstand and a pancake. But health is the one area he has not neglected; it is his strongest suit, which inverts the criterion the ICP is built on. Occupation and income were never established because the rep ran no baseline, so 'successful' and 'income' are recorded as misses on absence of evidence rather than on contrary evidence. The rep effectively disqualified him for being too far past good, which the stated ICP has no upper bound for — the criteria screen out the deconditioned but say nothing about a ceiling, and this call is where that gap shows.
